name: Nagafune Kojuurou
source:
3rd year student of the high school connected to Hakurouin University. Member of the Superhero club.
He was born into a family of blacksmiths with a long and ancient lineage. He has the soul of an artisan and isn't much interested in anything besides blacksmithing.
He has the superpower "Skill Smith" which he can use to create arms and armor to power up others abilities.
